headlines.headline: Kawhi Leonard trade to Raptors officially complete after months-long league investigation
headlines.detail: Clippers and Raptors finalized the deal sending Leonard to Toronto for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, a pick swap, and two second-rounders.

headlines.headline: Chiefs' Kenneth Walker III rushes for 173 yards in debut as KC routs Denver 31-10
headlines.detail: Walker's 60-yard TD run headlined Monday Night Football as Travis Kelce moved into second all-time in TE receiving yards; Week 1 tied the Super Bowl-era scoring record.

headlines.headline: LSU demolishes Clemson 51-10, piling pressure on Dabo Swinney
headlines.detail: Michigan escaped Western Michigan 13-12 on a controversial finish; Arch Manning, Jeremiah Smith, and CJ Carr lead early Heisman watch lists.

headlines.headline: Protect College Sports Act clears first procedural vote, 74-24
headlines.detail: Senate advances toward a final vote next week; Indiana lands 2027 commitment from German center Felix Kiehlneker.
